name: Anna Bhagya
description: Karnataka food-security support for eligible priority and Antyodaya ration-card households through the public distribution system.
eligibility_summary: Eligible BPL/PHH or AAY ration-card households, subject to Food Department verification and current distribution rules.
benefits: Food-security support through the public distribution system. Official sources describe changed rice and supplemental-food arrangements; confirm the current allocation with the Food Department. No current cash amount or exact statewide top-up entitlement is verified here.
eligibility: Hold an eligible BPL/PHH or Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration card.
Benefit allocation and identity requirements remain subject to current Food Department rules.
application_steps: Contact the local fair-price shop or Food Department to confirm the current Anna Bhagya entitlement linked to your ration card.
For ration-card or eligibility issues, use the Food Department’s officially notified service channels.
data_quality_notes: Ration-card eligibility verified via official district Food Department page. Ahara is an official department information/ration-service destination, not a verified Anna Bhagya application form; live reachability timed out. Current allocation/top-up entitlement and document list remain unverified.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
beneficiary: Eligible beneficiary families and senior citizens aged 70 years and above
description: Health assurance for covered secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals; not an unrestricted cash payment.
eligibility_summary: Eligible identified beneficiary families; coverage also extends to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status, under applicable rules.
benefits: Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for covered secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation. Coverage extends to senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status, under applicable rules.
eligibility: For the general beneficiary route, eligibility is based on the applicable beneficiary identification criteria.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible irrespective of socio-economic status, subject to scheme enrolment requirements.
application_steps: Use the official beneficiary portal or Ayushman App, or visit an empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre.
Complete enrolment and beneficiary identification through the selected official channel.
Use an empanelled hospital for covered treatment; covered procedures and authorisation remain subject to scheme rules.
data_quality_notes: Core cover and the age-70 senior-citizen extension verified via PIB. Required-documents list unavailable; general-route eligibility depends on beneficiary identification, not detailed public criteria.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Yojana
description: Karnataka direct-benefit support for eligible women heads of households. Detailed qualifying and exclusion rules must be confirmed with the Women and Child Development Department.
eligibility_summary: Eligible female heads of Karnataka households; the full current eligibility and exclusion checklist was not verified.
benefits: The official district welfare directory describes ₹2,000 per month through direct bank transfer to eligible women heads of households. Payment and eligibility remain subject to department rules.
application_steps: Check the current Gruha Lakshmi eligibility rules and intake availability with the Women and Child Development Department or its official service channel.
Apply only through a currently notified official channel and complete the requested verification; submitting an application does not guarantee approval.
data_quality_notes: Name, Rs 2,000/month benefit and women-head-of-household targeting verified via official district welfare directory. The supplied gl-stat-sns destination has historical official schedule/lookup references but timed out; its current purpose and availability are unverified, and it is not presented as an application form. Detailed eligibility/exclusions, documents and application URL remain unverified.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) – Post-Matric
beneficiary: Students applying for department-specific post-matric scholarships
description: Official Karnataka scholarship portal listing for post-matric scholarships administered by participating departments. SSP is a platform for multiple schemes, not one universal scholarship.
eligibility_summary: Eligibility depends on the selected department and scholarship. No universal income, caste, course or residence checklist is asserted here.
application_steps: Check the responsible department’s current post-matric scholarship notification and application dates.
Use the official SSP post-matric portal if available; follow the selected scheme’s registration, application and verification instructions.
Confirm scheme-specific benefits and required documents with the department. Current intake and the live portal workflow could not be verified.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Government scholarship platform with student registration, scheme information, scholarship applications and application tracking. NSP contains multiple scholarships with separate eligibility and benefits.
eligibility_summary: Select a scholarship and consult its current eligibility rules; NSP is not a universal scholarship.
application_steps: Read the Students page for scheme details, timelines and the current registration instructions.
Complete the required One Time Registration (OTR), then log in to the official scholarship application facility.
Choose the applicable scheme, complete the requested details and scheme-specific documents, and final-submit for institution and authority verification.
Check the selected scheme’s current notification; this listing does not assert an open application window.
data_quality_notes: Verified as a portal listing only: the official Students page supports scheme details, timelines, OTR and application access. Individual scholarship rules, benefits, documents and deadlines vary; no universal award or open intake is promised.

name: PM Vishwakarma
beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in the 18 covered trades
description: Central support for traditional artisans through recognition, skills, toolkit incentives, conditional credit and market linkages. Official scheme evidence does not guarantee that fresh registration is currently open.
eligibility_summary: Artisans aged at least 18 working in a covered family-based traditional trade on a self-employed/unorganised-sector basis, subject to family and prior-credit restrictions.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card. Skill training with stipend of ₹500 per day. Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 through an e-voucher. Collateral-free enterprise development loans: ₹1 lakh first tranche and ₹2 lakh second tranche at a concessional 5% interest rate, subject to training, loan-account and other tranche conditions; these are repayable loans, not grants. Digital transaction incentive of ₹1 per eligible transaction, up to 100 transactions monthly, and marketing support.
eligibility: Minimum age 18 on the registration date.
Work with hands and tools in one of the 18 covered family-based traditional trades in the unorganised sector on a self-employment basis.
Only one member per family; family means husband, wife and unmarried children.
Applicant and family members must not be in government service.

Subject to restrictions on similar Central/State credit-based self-employment or business-development scheme loans during the previous five years; confirm applicable exceptions with the implementing authority.
application_steps: Check the official portal or a Common Service Centre for current registration availability. Fresh registration being open has not been verified and is not guaranteed.
If intake is available, registration is facilitated by CSC agents on the official portal with Aadhaar biometric authentication.
Complete authority verification and required training; credit and subsequent benefits remain subject to their specific conditions.

eligibility_rules.occupation: traditional artisan or craftsperson in one of 18 covered trades (self-employed, unorganised sector)

data_quality_notes: Eligibility and benefits verified via PIB. Required-documents list unavailable; whether fresh registration is currently open was not verified.

name: PM Young Achievers’ Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
beneficiary: Eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students
description: Government of India umbrella programme supporting education of OBC, EBC and DNT students through pre-matric, post-matric and top-class education components, with an OBC hostel-construction component. Component administration and eligibility differ; this is not one uniform scholarship.
eligibility_summary: OBC, EBC or DNT students with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh, subject to the chosen component’s institution, class, selection and other rules.
benefits: Pre-matric component: ₹4,000 annual academic allowance for eligible Class IX–X government-school students, as described in the PIB explainer. Post-matric component: academic allowances ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 according to course category, as described in the explainer. Top-class school/college components support eligible students’ educational costs subject to component limits and selection; benefits are not automatically cumulative.
eligibility: Belong to an eligible OBC, EBC or DNT category.
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh, subject to component-specific rules.
Pre-matric component covers Classes IX and X in government schools.
Post-matric and top-class components have separate course, institution and selection conditions; confirm current guidelines before applying.
application_steps: Check the National Scholarship Portal and the responsible ministry/State authority for the relevant component and current academic-year notification. This record does not verify an open application window.
If the relevant application window is available, follow the notified registration and scholarship application process.
Submit the requested details for institution/authority verification and selection. Do not assume a historical entrance-test reference in the 2024 explainer is the current selection method.
data_quality_notes: Umbrella programme; income limit and category verified via PIB explainer. Component-specific institution, class, selection rules and document lists differ and were not individually verified.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
beneficiary: Eligible urban EWS, LIG and MIG households, depending on the component
description: Urban housing support through Beneficiary Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership, Affordable Rental Housing and Interest Subsidy Scheme. This record covers the urban scheme, not PMAY-Gramin.
eligibility_summary: Eligible urban households subject to income, house-ownership, prior-benefit and component-specific conditions.
benefits: BLC/AHP assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh for eligible EWS households, subject to the applicable funding pattern and conditions. Affordable rental housing for eligible EWS/LIG groups. Interest subsidy for eligible EWS/LIG/MIG home-loan borrowers under ISS conditions.
eligibility: Annual household income limits: EWS up to ₹3 lakh; LIG up to ₹6 lakh; MIG up to ₹9 lakh. Component eligibility varies.
Ownership assistance is subject to the condition that the beneficiary family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India and to applicable prior housing-assistance restrictions.
BLC requires eligible EWS beneficiaries to have available land.
ISS applies to eligible loans sanctioned and disbursed on or after 1 September 2024, subject to its detailed limits.
Families that received a house under a Central, State/UT or local-government housing scheme in the preceding 20 years are not eligible, under the guidelines.
documents: Proof of income for identification under the Interest Subsidy Scheme; other component-specific requirements must be confirmed with the implementing authority.
application_steps: Read the official eligibility instructions and confirm the appropriate component with the urban local body or implementing agency.
Check the current application facility on the official portal or contact the urban local body. Availability is not guaranteed by this record.
Submit the required information for authority verification; submitting a form does not establish entitlement.
data_quality_notes: Income limits, ownership and prior-benefit conditions verified against the PMAY-U 2.0 operational guidelines. Required documents are component-specific and only partly verified.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Central income support for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to land-record verification and scheme exclusions.
eligibility_summary: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to exclusion criteria and verification.
benefits: ₹6,000 per eligible family per year in three equal instalments through direct benefit transfer.
eligibility: Family comprises husband, wife and minor children.
Cultivable landholding must be recorded in the family’s name, subject to scheme rules.

Institutional landholders and specified higher-income categories are excluded, including income-tax payers and specified public office holders, government employees, pensioners and practising professionals; exceptions apply as specified in the official FAQ.
documents: Bank account number and IFSC details.
Cultivable-land ownership records for State/UT verification.
application_steps: Check current instructions on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Use the New Farmer Registration route or seek assistance from the designated local authority/CSC, where available.
Provide the requested identity, landholding and bank details; complete required e-KYC and verification. Registration does not guarantee approval or payment.

eligibility_rules.exclusions: income-tax payers and specified public-office/employee/professional categories excluded per official FAQ

data_quality_notes: Eligibility, exclusions, documents and application process verified against the official PM-KISAN FAQ. No fixed income limit applies; exclusion-based.

name: Shakti Scheme
description: Free travel for eligible Karnataka-resident women and gender minorities on specified state road transport services within Karnataka.
eligibility_summary: Karnataka residence and valid photo identity proof; only covered bus services and routes qualify.
benefits: Free travel on eligible ordinary and express services within Karnataka. Luxury buses, passes and chartered/package services are excluded; inter-state exceptions must be confirmed with the operator.
eligibility: Be a Karnataka-resident woman or covered gender-minority beneficiary; girls aged six and above are included by the official source.
Carry valid photo identity proof while travelling.
Use an eligible ordinary/express service within Karnataka; luxury services and excluded passes/packages do not qualify.
documents: Any one accepted original photo identity document or its DigiLocker version, such as Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence or passport, as specified by the operator.
application_steps: Check that the bus service and journey qualify for Shakti.
Present an accepted valid identity document during travel; follow the transport operator’s ticketing requirements.
data_quality_notes: Eligibility, identity-document requirement and service exclusions verified against the official district NIC page. No online application URL exists; benefit is used during travel.

description: Boarding and lodging assistance for eligible Backward Classes students studying post-matric courses who are not admitted to covered government or aided hostel/residential facilities.
eligibility_summary: Backward Classes post-matric students not admitted to Government/Government-aided hostels or departmental residential colleges; other current conditions must be confirmed.
benefits: Boarding and lodging assistance for eligible students. The current amount and academic-year application window were not verified and are intentionally not stated.
eligibility: Belong to the eligible Backward Classes student group.
Be studying a post-matric course.
Not be admitted to a Government or Government-aided hostel or a residential college of any department, as described by the official welfare directory.
Meet any additional current academic-year eligibility and selection rules published by the Backward Classes Welfare Department.
application_steps: Check the Backward Classes Welfare Department’s current Vidyasiri notification for eligibility, documents, application channel and dates.
Follow the currently notified process through the department or your institution; no open application window is implied.
data_quality_notes: Student group, post-matric requirement and hostel exclusion verified via official district welfare directory. Current benefit amount, document list and application window unverified.

eligibility: Be an eligible unemployed graduate or diploma holder in Karnataka.
Meet the current notified graduating-cohort and other eligibility conditions; an older cohort description must not be treated as universal current eligibility.
application_steps: Check the latest Yuva Nidhi notification and application availability on the official Seva Sindhu portal or with the District Skill Development Office.
